Use [XBoxB_Btn_DPad] to issue orders to your squad. [XBoxB_Btn_DPadU] to attack your target; [XBoxB_Btn_DPadD] to regroup and follow you; [XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [XBoxB_Btn_DPadR] for a single squadmate to attack your target or move to a point.

Press and hold [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to bring up the Power Wheel and pause the game. The Power Wheel lets you use the powers and special abilities of your squad.

While holding [XBoxB_Btn_RB], use [XBoxB_Btn_RS] to aim at a target and [XBoxB_Btn_LS] to highlight an ability on the Power Wheel. Press [XBoxB_Btn_A] to select. You may have 1 power or ability selected for each squad member. Release [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to unpause the game and use selected powers.
Hold [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to bring up the Power Wheel. Press [XBoxB_Btn_X] to quick-map 1 of Shepard's powers. Tap [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to use the quick-mapped power.

Haliat went through a lot of trouble to draw you here. A pity it ended like this. For him, at least.

Now that you're above ground, your suit radio has reestablished connection with the Normandy. Time to get the hell out of here.
Dr. Michel was being blackmailed by a guy who said he worked for Banes. Nobody seems to know much about this guy, but he's obviously very powerful.

Wards Access

The elevator at the end of this hallway leads to the Wards. There you will find Chora’s Den, Flux, the Markets, and the Medical Center.

Citadel Tower Elevator

This elevator leads up to the Citadel Tower, where the Council convenes to pass judgement on interstellar matters.

To C-Sec Academy

The elevator down to C-Sec Academy is far past the Emporium to your right and across the lake.  You will also find the Consort Chambers in this direction.

To Citadel Tower

The Citadel Tower is the tall white structure across the lake and to the left.  It houses the Council and is the heart of Citadel politics.

To Wards

The elevator down to the Wards is located across the plaza on the other side of the lake.  There you will find Chora’s Den, Flux, the Markets, and the Medical Center.

To C-Sec Academy

The elevator to C-Sec Academy is located down this ramp and past the small plaza.  The Alliance docking bay can be found there.

To C-Sec Academy

The elevator to the C-Sec Academy is located down the ramp just past the embassies to your right. The Alliance docking bay can be found there.

To Citadel Tower

The Citadel Tower is the tall white structure far to your left across the plaza.  It houses the Council and is the heart of Citadel politics.

To Wards

The elevator down to the Wards is located across the plaza far to your left. There you will find Chora’s Den, Flux, the Markets, and the Medical Center.

To C-Sec Academy

This elevator leads down to C-Sec Academy.  The Alliance docking bay can be found there.
To C-Sec and Embassies

To C-Sec Academy and Embassies

The Embassies are located at the end of this bridge just to the right.  Continue past the Embassies and down the ramp to find the elevator down to C-Sec Academy.

To C-Sec Academy

The elevator at the end of this hallway leads up to C-Sec Academy.  The Alliance docking bay can be found there.

To Presidium

This elevator leads up to the Presidium.  There you will find the Embassies, the Citadel Tower, the Emporium, the Bank, and the Consort Chambers.

Behind you is the Citadel Tower.  The Council convenes at the far end.
Mr. Bhatia was most grateful for your efforts in getting his wife's body returned.
This old, disabled vehicle was more willing to part with its still functioning power cell than one would expect.
You saved the quarian, and she gave you evidence linking Saren to the geth. Ambassador Udina is going to present this evidence to the Council.
Codex entries provide additional but nonessential information about topics of interest in Mass Effect.
Whenever you become lost, look to your Journal or Map for guidance.
Fire in short, controlled bursts to keep your weapon from overheating.
You lose accuracy as you fire your weapon. Fire in controlled bursts for maximum effect.
Use Zoom [XBoxB_Btn_LT] to improve your accuracy during combat.
Use the Equipment screen to equip or upgrade weapons, armor and other gear. Equipped items will not show up in the SELL window when you visit stores.
Weapons, ammo and other items can be customized by adding special mod upgrades to their mod slots.
Weapons have 2 upgrade slots. Armor and grenades each have 1 upgrade slot.
The squad screen lets you spend talent points to improve your skill with weapons, tech and biotics.
You get extra talent points every time you earn enough experience to gain a level.
Increasing your rank in certain talents unlocks powerful new abilities.
The Mako can evade incoming rockets using its jump jets
The Mako has two weapons: a heavy artillery cannon ([XBoxB_Btn_RB]) and an automatic chain gun ([XBoxB_Btn_RT]).
While in the Mako, you can look through the turret scope by holding [XBoxB_Btn_LT].
You can use your Repair skill to fix the Mako.
You can return to the Normandy from any uncharted world by going to the Map Screen and pressing [UI_XBoxB_Btn_X].
